Chat.title: PT MLM assistant
Chat.greeting: Hi! Ask me about ordering, payment, installments, delivery or order tracking.
Chat.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
Chat.answer_order: Open the Catalog, pick a product and fill in the order form. No account is needed.
Chat.answer_track: Open Track order and enter your order code and the phone number you used when ordering.
Chat.answer_payment: After you order, our team confirms and sends payment instructions. Your payment status shows on the Track order page.
Chat.answer_installment: At checkout you can choose to pay in full or in monthly installments. Each installment and its due date is shown on your order page.
Chat.answer_shipping: Orders are shipped after payment is confirmed. Follow the status (packed, shipped, delivered) on the Track order page.
Chat.answer_catalog: See all products and prices in the Catalog page.
Chat.answer_contact: Contact our team on WhatsApp: {whatsapp} or email {email}.
Chat.answer_fallback: I could not find an answer to that. Please contact our team on WhatsApp: {whatsapp}

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.question1: Do I need an account to order?
FAQ.answer1: No. You can order as a guest using your name and phone number. Signing in lets you see all your orders in one place.
FAQ.answer2: Yes. When ordering you can choose to pay in full or split the total into monthly installments.
FAQ.question3: How do I track my order?
FAQ.answer3: Use the Track order page with your order code and phone number to see payment and delivery status.
FAQ.question4: How can I contact PT MLM?
FAQ.answer4: Use the chat assistant, WhatsApp or email at the bottom of the page.
